blocks.text: Code42 is a cloud-native data security platform that provides real-time visibility, detection, and response capabilities to help organizations protect sensitive data from insider threats and data leaks.
The Code42 connector retrieves alerts from configured alert rules, including details on alert destinations and alert actors.

The Code42 source authentication configuration requires a client ID, client secret, and URL (i.e., a Code42 API client). To create API clients, you must be assigned the Customer Cloud Admin role. To learn more, refer to the Mimecast documentation.

blocks.item: In the Code42 console, go to Administration > Integrations > API Clients.
The Create new API client window appears.
In the Create new API client window:
Client name: Enter a name for the API credentials.
API Permissions: For Alerts, select the Read checkbox.
The generated client ID, client secret, and base URL are displayed.
Copy the client ID, secret, and base URL to be used in the connector setup process.
Save the secret securely as you cannot copy or view it later.

blocks.text: To create the Code42 data source in the Zscaler Security Operations (SecOps) platform:

blocks.item: Search for and select the connector tile from the available data sources.

blocks.text: After you create the Code42 data source, enter the following information in the source setup Retrieval section:

blocks.item: In the Authentication section, click Create New.
In the Code42 Authentication window, enter the information from the Prerequisites section.
To learn more, see Configuring Authentications and Managing Authentications.

Enter the number of days that you want to retrieve data for during each run. This value sets the lookback period (in days) from the current date. For example, enter 30 to fetch data from the past 30 days.

blocks.text: For complete configuration instructions, see Creating Data Sources.
